mechanism_narrative: A low level of the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS below 4.0% is associated with negative 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of observations over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 3.5% (annualized) signals persistent inflation, prompting the Fed to tighten policy and reduce equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL above 3.5% is associated with positive 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of observations over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in employment (PAYEMS) and fall in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal (PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling) fails to produce positive 60-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (characterized by high housing starts), the S&P 500 is prone to mean-reversion, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST above 1600.0 (thousands of units) is associated with positive 20-day forward returns in more than 40% of observations over a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates strengthening supply conditions, which reduces inflation expectations and leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO rising (3-month change > 0) is associated with negative 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of observations over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: HOUST below 1400.0 (thousands of units) signals weak housing market conditions, which typically precede economic slowdowns and lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST below 1400.0 is associated with positive 60-day forward returns in more than 40% of observations over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) and a stable or rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS > 4.0%) signals an aggressive monetary tightening cycle, which reduces equity valuations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint condition (CPIAUCSL>3.5% AND FEDFUNDS>4.0%) fails to produce negative 20-day forward returns in more than 50% of instances over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a strong retail sales regime (RSAFS above 700,000 million dollars), the S&P 500 is prone to short-term pullbacks, leading to negative forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: RSAFS above 700,000 million dollars is associated with positive 5-day forward returns in more than 40% of observations over a 3-year rolling window.
